title: SceneFile (.level.ron / .prefab.ron) v1
description: Regia Engine scene files, format version 1 (docs/formats/scene-files.md, specs/14 A2). RON maps to JSON loosely: an entity's component/resource values are opaque RON and appear as opaque strings here.

format_version.description: 11 (current), 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 or 1 (migrated on load: v2 added LevelSettings.atmosphere, v3 LevelSettings.look and the atmosphere's moons and haze, v4 LevelLook.lut, v5 SkyBody.fill_lux, v6 LevelSettings.audio_medium, v7 LevelMeter.bright_threshold_cd_m2 and bright_bias_ev, v8 LevelAtmosphere.aerosol_turbidity, v9 LevelLook.local_exposure, v10 LevelLook.baked_gi, v11 LevelLook.lightmap and the saved LightmapReceiver component). Loaders reject newer versions (specs/12 4a).

entities.description: Entity records. Order is irrelevant; parents may be declared after children.

resources.description: Resource values by full type path (e.g. regia_scene::level::LevelSettings).

guid.description: A GUID: 32 hex digits, dashes optional.

assetRef.description: An asset reference: 'asset:<guid>' (the prefix is optional when reading).

opaqueRon.description: One RON value, written in canonical form (specs/23 1). Decoded through reflection against the registered type.

typePath.description: A full Rust type path, e.g. regia_scene::transform::Transform.

name.description: Human-readable name (outliner, find-by-name). Never an addressing key.

parent.description: Parent entity guid; omit for a root. May reference an entity of the file or a prefab-internal local id.

components.description: Component values by full type path, one RON value each.

overrides.description: Per-field overrides on prefab-internal entities (outer wins over nested prefab values).

added_children.description: Entity subtrees created for this instance; parent may point at a prefab-internal guid or another added child.

removed_children.description: Prefab-internal local ids (with subtrees) not to instantiate.

path.description: Reflection field path with leading dot (.intensity, .color.x); empty or '.' replaces the whole component.
